def pair_cut_delta(self, pairs: Mapping[str, torch.Tensor],
                       frames: torch.Tensor | None = None) -> torch.Tensor:
        ctx = pairs["C"]
        sa = pairs["Sa"]
        sb = pairs["Sb"]
        bond = pairs["bond"]
        n = int(ctx.numel())
        s_ids = torch.cat([sb, sa], dim=0)
        c_ids = torch.cat([ctx, ctx], dim=0)
        b = torch.cat([bond, bond], dim=0)
        f = self.cut_scores(s_ids, c_ids, b, frames)
        return f[:n] - f[n:]

def pair_cut_delta(self, pairs: Mapping[str, torch.Tensor],
                       phi: torch.Tensor | None = None) -> torch.Tensor:
        ctx = pairs["C"]
        sa = pairs["Sa"]
        sb = pairs["Sb"]
        uniq, inv = torch.unique(torch.cat([ctx, sa, sb]), sorted=True, return_inverse=True)
        h = self.encode_fragments(uniq, phi)
        n = int(ctx.numel())
        h_c = h[inv[:n]]
        h_a = h[inv[n:2 * n]]
        h_b = h[inv[2 * n:]]
        e = self._cut_embedding(pairs["bond"])
        return self.cut_scores(h_c, h_b, e) - self.cut_scores(h_c, h_a, e)
